shellCommands.command: pwd && ls -la && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5

cat package.json && echo ---- && cat index.html && echo ---- && cat vite.config.ts && echo ---- && cat tsconfig.json && echo ---- && cat .gitignore && echo ---- && find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo ---- && for f in $(find src -type f); do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ | head -30 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E '^(tsc|vite)$'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && cat esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; ls esm/components/layout 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "Title" esm/components/index.d.ts esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -n "variant" components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; cat components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat components/Button/constants.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p components/layout/Container/Container.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; grep -n "export" components/layout/index.d.ts; echo ----; cat components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -30
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -i -E "^playwright|^puppeteer" ; echo "exit: done"

npm run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && (npx vite preview --port 4173 --strictPort >/tmp/preview.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 3 && curl -s localhost:4173 | head -12 && echo && JS=$(curl -s localhost:4173 | grep -o 'assets/index-[^"]*\.js' | head -1) && curl -s "localhost:4173/$JS" | grep -o -E "Учёт в один клик|Видно загрузку команды|Отчёты без ручной работы|Попробуйте на своей команде|Начать работу" | sort | uniq -c; pkill -f "vite preview" ; rm -rf dist; git status --short
for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | grep "vite preview" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'); do kill $p; done; sleep 1; ps -eo args | grep "vite preview" | grep -v grep || echo "preview server stopped"

curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4173 || true; for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do if tr '\0' ' ' < $d/cmdline 2>/dev/null | grep -q "vite preview"; then echo "killing ${d#/proc/}"; kill ${d#/proc/}; fi; done; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4173 || echo "port 4173 closed"
